video_caption: A dark-skinned man with long black dreadlocks, wearing a light grey t-shirt, is seen speaking directly to the camera from an indoor setting with white shelves, a wooden staircase, and a window in the background. He uses expressive hand gestures, pointing and spreading his hands, as he explains what a "MasterClass" is. The scene then transitions to him sitting outdoors on a concrete step, scrolling through a silver smartphone. An Instagram screen recording (labeled "22 HOURS AGO" and "TIMBALAND Sponsored") appears, showing a video of Timbaland, a dark-skinned man with short hair, clapping his hands in a studio, then sitting and talking, with a "MASTERCLASS" logo visible. The video cuts back to the man with dreadlocks, who points upwards as a series of overlaid images flash on screen: Missy Elliott holding two Grammy awards, Aaliyah winking with a VMA logo in the background, Timbaland with Nelly Furtado, and Timbaland with Justin Timberlake at an MTV event. The man with dreadlocks returns to the main frame, continuing to speak with animated gestures, including widely spread hands, a single clap, and hands brought together as if in prayer, maintaining an enthusiastic expression.

A man with dark skin and dreadlocks, wearing a light-colored t-shirt, addresses the camera directly, gesturing with his right hand. A red YouTube-style "Subscribe" button with a white play icon appears on the screen, and a white mouse pointer clicks it. The button instantly changes to a grey "Subscribed" button with a white checkmark. Subsequently, a white bell icon appears next to it, which the mouse pointer clicks, causing red "ringing" lines and a red dot to emanate from the bell, signifying that notifications have been activated. A RØDE microphone is visible in the bottom left of the frame, and the background reveals a brightly lit indoor space with a staircase, white shelves, and a white surfboard leaning against a wall. The scene then transitions to a black screen featuring a white circular logo with three wavy lines at the bottom, and the white text "Ocean Gang Or Drown" (English) appears below it.

The video opens with a dark-skinned man with dreadlocks, wearing a light-colored t-shirt, speaking directly to the camera from an indoor setting. He gestures with his hands as he talks, with a large microphone visible to his left and shelves, a wooden staircase, and a surfboard in the background. At 00:03, the video transitions to a screen recording of a website. The URL reads `https://www.masterclass.com/classes/timbaland-teaches-producing-and-beatmaking/enrolled`. The page is titled "TIMBALAND TEACHES PRODUCING AND BEATMAKING" and displays a "LESSON PLAN." The first two lessons, "Introduction" and "Studio Session: Making a Beatbox Beat," are marked with purple checkmarks, indicating completion. Subsequent lessons include "Building Beats: Tim's Process," "Making a Beat: Getting Warmed Up," and "Song Origins: "Dirt Off Your Shoulder"." At 00:05, the video cuts back to the man, who continues to speak to the camera, gesturing with his right hand, pointing his finger, and then touching his chin, seemingly emphasizing details about the Masterclass content.

A dark-skinned man with dreadlocks, wearing a light-colored t-shirt, is centered in the frame, speaking directly to the camera. He actively uses various hand gestures to emphasize his points, including raising an open palm, pointing an index finger, and making expressive motions with both hands, at one point clenching his fists. A black microphone with a "RODE" logo is visible in the lower-left foreground, suggesting he is recording. The background features an indoor setting with a wooden staircase and railing behind him, a white shelving unit filled with various items and a white refrigerator to his left, and a window with white curtains and a green object (possibly a surfboard) leaning against the wall to his right. The room has a tiled floor and appears to be a well-lit home or studio environment.

A man with long dreadlocks and a white t-shirt sits at a wooden desk with a laptop displaying audio software, a Rode microphone, and a small red and white MIDI keyboard. He introduces that he will make a beat from a beatbox, then begins to sing into the microphone, adding different layers of vocal sounds and effects. Text overlays appear throughout the video, indicating each new layer he adds: "MELODY" (00:11), "COUNTER MELODY" (00:29), "HI HATS" (00:45), "RANDOM BREATHING FX" (01:01), "...AND AGAIN" (01:17), "KICK AND SNARE" (01:33), "CLAP" (01:49), "PERC" (02:05), "SECOND PERC" (02:21), and "FINAL PERC SAUCE!" (02:37). As he adds each layer, he taps his fingers on the MIDI keyboard, moves his head in rhythm, and gestures with his hands, indicating the different sounds he is producing. The background shows a light-colored room with a white shelf unit on the left, a surfboard leaning against the wall on the right, and a TV mounted on the far wall. He appears focused and expressive, particularly when adding the "FINAL PERC SAUCE!", where he enthusiastically uses both hands to tap the keyboard and moves his body with the beat.

A young man with dark skin and dreadlocks, wearing a light-colored t-shirt, is seated at a wooden desk, speaking directly to the camera. He initially has his mouth slightly open as he talks, then brings his hands together in a clasping motion before gesticulating with his right hand, pointing his index finger. To his left, a silver laptop is open on the desk, displaying a digital audio workstation (DAW) interface, likely Logic Pro X. Next to the laptop, a professional microphone with a pop filter that reads "RODE" is set up on a stand. Behind the microphone, a small black and red MIDI keyboard is partially visible. In the background, a black flat-screen TV is mounted on a white wall, and further to the right, part of a bed with pillows and a green patterned cover can be seen, suggesting a home studio or bedroom setting.

The video opens with white text "2000 YEARS LATER" displayed on a brown and gold patterned background, followed by "LITERALLY..." on a black screen, indicating a significant passage of time. A man with dreadlocks, wearing a white t-shirt and black headphones, sits at a desk with a white MIDI keyboard in a brightly lit room with white shelves and a staircase in the background. He claps his hands and gestures as he explains editing a beat. The screen then splits, showing his Logic Pro digital audio workstation (DAW) on the left, displaying multiple tracks including "Melody 1" with applied "Channel EQ" and "AUlowpass" effects, and "Melody 2." He demonstrates adding a piano melody (Inst 6) and panning multiple piano melody tracks (Inst 6) to the left and right, forming a V-shape in the sound. The man is seen playing his MIDI keyboard while mentioning a "Shadow Dynasty sample," which he then processes in the DAW with various effects like "SoundShift," "Channel EQ," and "iZotope Vinyl." He then uses the "SoundShifter Pitch" plugin to adjust the sample's tuning by -2 semitones. Finally, he plays the complete melody with all the layered and processed tracks, tapping his fingers to the beat.

The video segment opens with a man, wearing headphones and a white t-shirt, sitting at a desk with a laptop and a small MIDI keyboard, gesturing with his right hand as if explaining something. The scene then transitions to a screen recording of music production software (Logic Pro X), where the man is visible in a smaller window in the top right corner, continuing to interact with his laptop and MIDI keyboard. The software displays multiple tracks, including "Ultrabeat," "Huff," "Kick," and "Clap," and the timeline indicates a tempo of "140 BPM" in "4/4" time signature, set to "Cmaj." He demonstrates adding different drum elements, showcasing how alternating velocities on the hi-hats create variation, then layering in a kick, clap, and a subtle snare. The man then looks directly at the camera, clapping his hands, and explains he’s adding “air candy” to give the drums more bounce, returning to the screen recording to show the addition of various percussion tracks, including a shaker. He briefly plays a subtle percussive sound on his MIDI keyboard, then explains how he recorded it and reduced its volume to blend into the background, showcasing the volume slider for "Perc 2" being adjusted to -11.0 dB and then -14.2 dB. He then returns to looking at the camera, talking about adding a sub-bass with effects like "Massive," "Overdrive," "AUlowpass," "Channel EQ," and "Phaser" shown on screen. The final part of the segment shows the full beat playing, revealing a more complete track list with elements like "Melody 1" and "Melody 2," and the man in the top right window nods his head to the rhythm. The video ends with a close-up of the man looking at the camera.

The video opens with a man with dark skin and dreadlocks, wearing a white t-shirt, speaking directly to the camera while gesturing with his hands. He is in what appears to be a living room with a staircase and white shelves in the background, along with a surfboard leaning against a wall by a window. Briefly, at 0:09, the scene cuts to a different man with short hair and a dark sleeveless top, sitting in a studio-like room with wooden sound-absorbing panels, looking thoughtful and moving his arm. The video then returns to the first man, who continues to talk animatedly, using his hands to emphasize his points. At 0:29, the scene shifts to a man identified as Jay-Z, wearing a white t-shirt, standing in a room with purple walls and audio equipment, looking around thoughtfully. The man with dreadlocks reappears, still talking and gesturing, before the video transitions to a man in a white t-shirt, a red and blue baseball cap, and multiple necklaces, holding a microphone and smiling broadly as he sings or raps. He is flanked by two other individuals holding microphones, suggesting an interview or performance setting in a brightly lit television studio.

The video segment features a Black man with dreadlocks, wearing a white t-shirt, speaking directly to the camera in an indoor setting. He uses various hand gestures as he talks, including pointing his right index finger upwards, then downwards, raising both index fingers, and forming an "OK" sign with his right hand. The background reveals a room with a white shelving unit, a wooden staircase, and a green surfboard leaning against a wall. At 00:10, the scene transitions to a black screen displaying a YouTube comment by "Jason Morin," which reads: "Thank you for the good and kind words regarding our Ample Guitar Martin Lite (AGML). Also check out our Free Ample Bass Precision Lite (ABPL) and also our FREE Cloudrum. All available here: https://www.amplesound.net/en/download.asp. They all are compatible for PC" (This comment expresses gratitude and promotes music software). The video then cuts back to the man at 00:11, who points towards the camera, claps his hands once, points again, and makes a sweeping gesture with his right hand from left to right. At 00:16, the video shifts to a black outro screen with white text, showing a large white rectangle on the top left labeled "CHECK OUT MY NEXT VIDEO" (English), a "SUBSCRIBE NOW" (English) button with a white arrow on the top right, and "FOLLOW ON INSTAGRAM: @PRODBYOCEAN" (English) at the bottom.
